title: Kajian Kitab Rongawi Bersama Reza Auditore (Ferry Irwandi)
caveats: Labeled from YouTube Indonesian captions with inline sound-event tags only; the video was not watched, so on-screen memes and visual gags were not assessed.
Caption text garbles names and numbers (e.g. '4 juta' appears as 'R juta', Reza as 'Eja Auditori'); boundaries snap to caption segments, not exact words.
Speaker turns (host Ferry Irwandi vs guest Reza 'Eja' Auditore) are inferred from context; some caption segments merge both speakers.
G4 is the single allowed deep-dive (>90 s); a tighter cut from about 641 s to 726 s is an acceptable alternative.
Content is crude adult humor (jomok, genital references); FYP appeal assumes a platform-safe edit with bleeps or blur.
Single subjective labeler; adjacent spans (G2/G3, G7/G11, G9/T5) are deliberately separate clips to test boundary precision.
